sloka: दिव्यानि च सुगन्धीनि माल्यदामानि रावणः।श्रोत्रे चासञ्जयामास श्रीमती चास्य कुण्डले ।। ६.६५.२७ ।।
transliteration: divyāni ca sugandhīni mālyadāmāni rāvaṇaḥ।śrotre cāsañjayāmāsa śrīmatī cāsya kuṇḍale ।। 6.65.27 ।।

translations.english: Ravana then placed his crown, wonderful fragrant garlands and rich suspended earrings on Kumbhakarna.
